takeaway: Cystic hygroma: a lymphangioma that usually presents in childhood, typically in the neck, and transilluminates.

lines.text: A fourteen-year-old girl has a soft, fluctuant lump on the right side of her neck.
It measures 2 cm and sits next to the angle of the mandible.
lines.say: It measures two centimetres and sits next to the angle of the mandible.

lines.text: and it is cystic on ultrasound.
This is a cystic hygroma: a lymphangioma that usually presents in childhood.
Cystic hygromas typically occur in the neck, and they transilluminate.
So in this young girl, the diagnosis is cystic hygroma.
